instructions.question: Does this comment show sincere approval (positive), explicit hostility or despair (negative), or neither (neutral)?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default: plain questions, discrepancies, forecasts, mild worry, advice, complaints without insult, tags or names, off-topic chat, ads, and laughing banter or city-ranking jokes. Negative needs a trigger: a curse, an insult word, blame of the government, a claim that the Institute lies (any spelling), ridicule of the Institute's competence, sarcastic praise, or a horror or despair word; banter alone is not enough. Positive needs an expressed approving feeling: thanks, praise, blessings, congratulations, encouragement, or clear joy at falling cases or recoveries, even alongside criticism. A thanks that only prefaces a question is neutral.

neutral.what: The default: questions, doubts, discrepancies, forecasts, mild worry, advice, complaints without insult, tags, banter and jokes.
examples: Kta a jon me teste a veq me sy t'testum? (Are these with tests or just tested by eye?)
Mirupafshim ne Shtator e pat puna juv mo keni ra pi liges sikur Hajvalia... (See you in September, you've been relegated like Hajvalia...)
Dedë Valdrin ma gjall ma gjall (Dedë Valdrin, faster, faster)
neutral.cues: tagged names, hahaha, pse (why), a jon (are they), duhet (should), karantin (quarantine), maska (masks), per marakli (worth worrying about), liga (league)
neutral.not_for: A curse, insult, government blame, lying claim, horror word or ridicule of the Institute makes it negative.

positive.what: Sincere thanks or praise, blessings, congratulations, encouragement, joy at falling cases or recoveries.
examples: Lakorja paska fillu me ra (The curve has started to fall)
Hallall ju koft si ju ne kosov qe pi sheroni  pacientet nga Covid 19 (Well done to you in Kosovo for curing patients)
Ta mundim kete pandemi te gjithe se bashku (Let's beat this pandemic all together)
positive.cues: ju lumt (well done), hallall, bravo, respekt (respect), flm (thanks), perhajr (congratulations), ka ra numri (number fell), te sherum (recovered), Zoti na ruajt (God protect us)
positive.not_for: Tags or names ('Urim Skeraj'), off-topic chat, ads, city cheering ('forza peja', 'Perpara Prishtina') and suggestions ('Postoni mire' (post well)) are neutral. Sarcastic praise is negative.

negative.what: Curses, insults, government blame, lying claims, ridicule of the Institute, sarcastic praise, horror or despair.
examples: ona mytet tu na rrejt (they're killing us with lies)
183 a 195 se ju ka hup topi diçka kohëve të fundit (183 or 195, you've lost the plot lately)
Tmerrshem (Horrible)
Mashalla ka hi qeveria e re me kom te mire gjdo dite ma shum raste (Mashallah, the new government came in lucky, more cases daily)
negative.cues: rren/ren/rrejt/genjeshtra (lie), fajet (to blame), injorant (ignorant), palaqo/bosa/huti (fool), qifsha (vulgar), tmer (horror), katastrof (catastrophe), ma keq (worse), ZEZA (disaster)
negative.not_for: Laughing banter, or neutral questions about numbers without ridicule or a lying claim, is neutral.
